from: The manager's explanation of the plan was clear to everyone.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort clearly muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word clearly must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: clearly darf nicht zwischen explained und the plan stehen.
wrong.en: clearly cannot sit between explained and the plan.

wrong.de: Das Verb steht mit seinem Objekt zusammen, das Adverb davor oder dahinter.
wrong.en: Verb and object stay together; the adverb goes before or after.

wrong.en: carefully cannot sit between checked and every number.

wrong.en: The object every number follows the verb directly. The adverb goes before or after.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt bei „clearly the results“: Verb und Objekt bleiben zusammen.
wrong.en: The error is in “clearly the results”: verb and object stay together.

wrong.en: No error: the adverb really goes before the verb. That is correct.

q.de: Welche Sätze sagen: Er hat schnell geantwortet?

prompt: We are meeting in Denver the client tomorrow.

prompt: We are holding the workshop in Munich on Friday.

ok.en: Right: both. Place before time is usual; the other order is possible too.

wrong.en: Sentence a is right, but b gives the same facts: place and time may swap here.

wrong.de: Satz b stimmt, aber a nennt dasselbe: Ort und Zeit dürfen hier tauschen.
wrong.en: Sentence b is right, but a gives the same facts: place and time may swap here.
